items.description: Demonstrated fabricated evidence or copied reference numbers represented as independently calculated invalidate the submission.

Demonstrated unauthorized hidden-evaluator answer use invalidates the submission. Ordinary calculation failure, unsupported identity, numerical mismatch or missing conclusion only affects the relevant scientific items.

local_failure_policy: Unsupported conclusions fail only the affected items with reasons; supported independent conclusions retain points. No need_review scoring state. Demonstrated reference defects are recorded separately in objective_issue_flags.
ordinary_failure_policy: Unsupported conclusions fail only the affected items with reasons; supported independent conclusions retain points. No need_review scoring state. Demonstrated reference defects are recorded separately in objective_issue_flags.
